# openwebui_tool (Resource)

Manages a Python tool in Open WebUI. Tools expose callable functions to language models.

~> **Note:** if an Open WebUI admin disables the `ENABLE_PLUGINS` setting (introduced in v0.11.0, default enabled), the export endpoint this resource uses to read back `content`/`specs_json` returns an empty list, which will read back as empty content on the next `terraform plan`/`apply`. CRUD by ID is unaffected — only this fetch-back path.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openwebui_tool" "example" {
  tool_id     = "web_scraper"
  name        = "Web Scraper"
  description = "Fetches and parses web page content"
  content     = file("${path.module}/tools/web_scraper.py")

  read_groups  = ["Support"]
  write_groups = ["Support"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content` (String) Python source code that defines the tool's functions.
- `name` (String) Display name of the tool.
- `tool_id` (String) Unique identifier for the tool, e.g. `web_scraper`. Forces replacement.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Short description shown in the Open WebUI interface.
- `manifest_json` (String) JSON manifest derived from the source frontmatter. Read-only; set by Open WebUI.
- `read_groups` (List of String) Names of groups granted read access to the tool, spelled exactly as stored in Open WebUI (state holds the stored group name, so an ID or a different letter case shows up as a difference). Open WebUI stores every write group as a read group too, so this list always includes the `write_groups` entries. When `read_groups` is not set, its planned value keeps the current read groups and is extended with any `write_groups` entry missing from it. When it is set, it must include every write group: to remove a group from `read_groups`, remove it from `write_groups` too (or set `write_groups = []`). Set both lists to `[]` for no group grants.
- `write_groups` (List of String) Names of groups granted write access to the tool, spelled exactly as stored in Open WebUI. Open WebUI stores these groups as read groups too: when `read_groups` is set it must list every group here, and when it is not set it is extended with them automatically. Leaving `write_groups` unset keeps the current write groups; set it to `[]` to revoke write access.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (Number) Unix timestamp of creation. Set by Open WebUI.
- `id` (String) UUID assigned by Open WebUI on create.
- `specs_json` (String) JSON OpenAPI-style specification of the tool's functions. Read-only; set by Open WebUI.
- `updated_at` (Number) Unix timestamp of last update. Set by Open WebUI.
- `user_id` (String) Owner user identifier. Set by Open WebUI.
- `write_access` (Boolean) Whether the authenticated user has write access to this tool. Read-only; set by Open WebUI.
